brief: TME compiles several desks: technicals, flows and fundamentals are aligning for a Q4 squeeze. NDX is nearing a 31,200 futures level after months of consolidation and SOX is breaking short-term resistance. GS says hyperscaler debt issuance is set to reach $420bn by 2027 yet interest expense stays a small share of hyperscaler earnings, so higher yields haven't derailed AI capex. MS puts hyperscaler net leverage at 0.4x with cash at 132% of debt, meaning no balance-sheet constraint yet. GS also says memory and HBM pricing expectations were washed out and are now recovering, so a technical breakout could force buyers back into the trade. Rubner (Citadel) says US equity CTA positioning swung from +2.35 standard deviations at end-August to -0.80 now, over 3 sigma in a month, while $1.3tn of authorized corporate buybacks resumes as windows reopen from October 15, accelerating into November, against Q4 midterm-year seasonality averaging 5.6% S&P gains versus 2.9% across all years. GS flags a thinner oil inventory buffer: a renewed Gulf disruption below 50% of flows would have less room to absorb, while oil volatility stays calm near $100 crude. JPM says Taiwan's AI hardware earnings backdrop remains intact, citing TSMC's 100%+ utilization at N3/N5.
